<section class="partners-hero">

    <h1>Built with the world's best institutions</h1>
    <p class="partners-hero-lede">OpenSpace is an international collaboration between universities, science museums, and planetariums united by a shared mission to make space exploration accessible to everyone.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="partners-section">
  <h2 class="partners-section-heading">University Partners</h2>

    </a>

    <a class="partner-card" href="https://www.sci.utah.edu/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <div class="partner-logo-area">
        <img class="partner-logo" src="assets/images/logos/SCI-logo-transparent-white.webp" alt="SCI Institute">

      <p class="partner-name">SCI Institute — University of Utah</p>
      <p class="partner-blurb">An internationally recognized leader in visualization and scientific computing, SCI develops robust open-source software packages deployed broadly across scientific research communities.</p>

<div class="partners-section">

    <a class="partner-card" href="https://www.calacademy.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
